tQTLExperiment: a SummarizedExperiment for tensorQTL eQTL mapping. tQTLExperiment extends SummarizedExperiment::RangedSummarizedExperiment to hold all data needed for the tensorQTL eQTL mapping tool:

Source: R/tQTLExperiment-class.R
tQTLExperiment-class.Rd

  • assays: phenotype matrix (features × samples)

  • rowRanges: genomic coordinates for each phenotype feature (gene)

  • colData: per-sample metadata including covariates

  • geno: lazy BEDMatrix::BEDMatrix over the PLINK .bed file (samples × variants); data are not loaded until subscripted

  • variantRanges: GenomicRanges::GRanges for each variant, with metadata columns snp_id, ref, alt

  • plinkPrefix: path prefix for the PLINK file set

  • tqtlResultsDir: path to a directory of tensorQTL cis_nominal parquet output, bound by readTQTL() after a successful run, and queried lazily (without loading the whole table) via tqtlResults()

Details

tensorQTL is invoked via its CLI (python -m tensorqtl) and supports GPU acceleration through CUDA or Apple MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) on Apple Silicon.

Slots

geno

A BEDMatrix::BEDMatrix (samples × variants).

variantRanges

A GenomicRanges::GRanges of length equal to ncol(geno).

plinkPrefix

A length-one character string giving the PLINK file prefix.

tqtlResultsDir

A length-one character string giving the directory of bound cis_nominal tensorQTL output, or NA_character_ if none has been bound yet.

See also

tQTLExperiment() for the constructor, prepareTQTL() to write input files and get the CLI command, readTQTL() to load results, tqtlResults() to query bound results lazily, findTQTL() to locate Python.
